title: Introducing The New Asseta
summary: Asseta has a new brand. The same platform you rely on, with an identity built to reflect the families and offices we serve.
body_markdown:
Asseta has a new look.


A new identity. A new palette. A new website. One product, built to the same standard it has always been held to, now presented at that standard too.


What is the point of wealth without significance? What is the worth of digits in an account if there is no long term value?


The most storied decisions are driven by impact. Legacy. Significance. Not wealth for wealth's sake, but wealth that stands for something.


Wealth that connects to the best networks, the brightest ideas, and the promise of generational earnings as well as generational access.


That is Asseta.


Every detail, from the wordmark to the site now live at asseta.ai, was built around that idea. Nothing about the platform has changed except where it has gotten better.


See the new Asseta at[asseta.ai](https://asseta.ai/) .


Lead with Legacy.
